approval.standard: eastward-edges.md 5.1 and 5.5, art-style.md density 3; the Frostline brief (snow lying on what faces the sky, granite and slate, lake ice)
approval.note: The short thaw band at the woodland's north seam (Matt, 23 Nov) across the zone's width, its top edge wandering: a calm wet crust, bare hollows lit from the upper left growing and merging toward the seam, earth in clusters with combed flattened grass, meandering rivulets to the water, a trodden slush lane on the Col Path to the door, the snow pulled back round the trees' feet.

audit.size_class: unsized (wet snow and bare ground: ground dressing)
